full_list.title_en: Hydrogen Storage on Transition-Metal-Decorated Nitrogen-Modified Carbon Nanoribbons
full_list.title_zh: 过渡金属修饰氮改性碳纳米带上的储氢研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently synthesized carbon nanoribbons (CNRs) were investigated for hydrogen (H2) storage using first-principles density functional theory calculations. Pristine CNRs exhibited weak H2 adsorption; therefore, the host structure was modified by substituting carbon atoms at the C-H edges with 12 nitrogen atoms, followed by Mn and Y doping to enhance H2 binding. A maximum of five metal atoms could be accommodated on the 12N-CNRs. Electronic structure analysis revealed strong orbital hybridization between the metal atoms and the CNRs, while binding energy calculations confirmed the structural stability of the doped systems. Bader charge analysis further quantified the charge transfer between the metal atoms and the host structure. The average H2 adsorption energies were calculated to be -0.40 eV/H2 for the Mn-doped system and -0.25 eV/H2 for the Y-doped system, which are within the desirable range for reversible hydrogen storage. The maximum theoretical gravimetric storage capacities at 0 K reached 7.48 wt% for the Mn-doped system and 6.55 wt% for the Y-doped system. Under practical conditions of 30 atm and 298.15 K, the storage capacity of the Y-doped system decreased to 6.04 wt%, whereas the Mn-doped system maintained its full capacity of 7.48 wt%. Thermodynamic analysis indicated that H2 adsorption is favored at low temperatures and high pressures, while desorption becomes feasible at elevated temperatures and lower pressures. These results demonstrate that Mn- and Y-doped CNRs satisfy key U.S. Department of Energy requirements for reversible H2 storage and show promise as potential hydrogen storage materials under near-ambient conditions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算了新近合成碳纳米带的储氢性能，并通过边缘碳原子被12个氮原子取代以及Mn、Y掺杂来增强氢吸附。Mn掺杂和Y掺杂体系的平均氢吸附能分别为−0.40和−0.25电子伏特/氢分子，理论质量储氢容量分别达到7.48%和6.55%。在298.15开尔文、30个大气压下，Y体系容量降至6.04%，而Mn体系保持7.48%的完整容量，显示出其在接近环境条件下可逆储氢的潜力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 研究人员利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，研究了新近合成碳纳米带（CNR）的储氢（H2）性能。原始CNR表现出较弱的H2吸附能力；因此，通过将C—H边缘处的碳原子替换为12个氮原子对主体结构进行改性，随后进行Mn和Y掺杂以增强H2结合能力。12N-CNR最多可容纳五个金属原子。电子结构分析显示，金属原子与CNR之间存在强轨道杂化，而结合能计算证实了掺杂体系的结构稳定性。Bader电荷分析进一步量化了金属原子与主体结构之间的电荷转移。Mn掺杂体系和Y掺杂体系的平均H2吸附能分别为−0.40电子伏特/H2和−0.25电子伏特/H2，处于适合可逆储氢的理想范围内。在0开尔文下，理论最大质量储氢容量分别达到7.48%和6.55%。在30个大气压、298.15开尔文的实际条件下，Y掺杂体系的储氢容量降至6.04%，而Mn掺杂体系保持其7.48%的全部容量。热力学分析表明，H2吸附在低温和高压下更有利，而脱附在较高温度和较低压力下更易实现。这些结果表明，Mn和Y掺杂CNR满足美国能源部关于可逆储氢的关键要求，并显示出其在接近环境条件下作为潜在储氢材料的应用前景。
full_list.summary: 研究利用第一性原理密度泛函理论计算了新近合成碳纳米带的储氢性能，并通过边缘碳原子被12个氮原子取代以及Mn、Y掺杂来增强氢吸附。Mn掺杂和Y掺杂体系的平均氢吸附能分别为−0.40和−0.25电子伏特/氢分子，理论质量储氢容量分别达到7.48%和6.55%。在298.15开尔文、30个大气压下，Y体系容量降至6.04%，而Mn体系保持7.48%的完整容量，显示出其在接近环境条件下可逆储氢的潜力。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文采用第一性原理密度泛函理论研究过渡金属修饰、氮掺杂碳纳米带的储氢性能，比较了 Mn 和 Y 掺杂体系的结构稳定性、轨道杂化、吸附能和电荷转移。结果表明，Mn 和 Y 掺杂体系的平均氢分子吸附能分别约为负零点四和负零点二五电子伏特，并具有较高的理论质量储氢容量。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理材料设计、二维低维材料、能源材料、化学掺杂和高通量筛选方向直接相关。其对吸附能、电荷转移和实际温压条件下储氢容量的综合评估，可借鉴到锂电池材料、固态电解质及其他能源材料的设计中。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步检验不同金属覆盖度、氢分子间相互作用及有限温度动力学稳定性，并结合机器学习势开展更大尺度的吸附、扩散和脱附过程模拟。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《过渡金属修饰氮改性碳纳米带上的储氢研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Learning Hamiltonians for solid-state quantum simulators
full_list.title_zh: 面向固态量子模拟器的哈密顿量学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.02889v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a generalizable framework for identifying effective Hamiltonians directly from experimental data in solid-state quantum systems. Our unsupervised autoencoder-based approach incorporates the governing physics (here, the S-matrix formalism) directly into the decoder, enabling physically meaningful Hamiltonian inference without labeled Hamiltonian parameters. Through numerical experiments on a triple quantum dot chain, we demonstrate automated characterization of programmable solid-state simulators from transport measurements. The model accurately infers Hamiltonian parameters and generalizes beyond the training domain, while exhibiting finite capacity as the parameter space becomes increasingly broad or diverse. We further demonstrate robustness to noisy measurements and show that the model can be successfully trained on transport data generated outside the Hamiltonian family assumed by the physics decoder, while still identifying meaningful effective parameters.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可推广框架，用于直接从固态量子系统实验数据中识别有效哈密顿量。该无监督自编码器方法将 S 矩阵形式主义等物理约束嵌入解码器，无需带标签的哈密顿量参数即可进行有物理意义的推断。三重量子点链数值实验表明，该模型可从输运测量中自动表征可编程固态模拟器，并具有噪声鲁棒性和一定域外泛化能力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种可推广框架，用于直接从固态量子系统的实验数据中识别有效哈密顿量。我们的基于无监督自编码器的方法将支配物理（此处为 S 矩阵形式主义）直接纳入解码器，从而在没有带标签哈密顿量参数的情况下实现具有物理意义的哈密顿量推断。通过在三重量子点链上的数值实验，我们展示了如何从输运测量中自动表征可编程固态模拟器。该模型能够准确推断哈密顿量参数，并泛化到训练域之外，同时在参数空间变得越来越宽或越来越多样时表现出有限容量。我们进一步展示了其对噪声测量的鲁棒性，并表明即使输运数据是在物理解码器所假设的哈密顿量族之外生成的，该模型仍可成功训练，同时仍能识别有意义的有效参数。
full_list.summary: 本文提出一种可推广框架，用于直接从固态量子系统实验数据中识别有效哈密顿量。该无监督自编码器方法将 S 矩阵形式主义等物理约束嵌入解码器，无需带标签的哈密顿量参数即可进行有物理意义的推断。三重量子点链数值实验表明，该模型可从输运测量中自动表征可编程固态模拟器，并具有噪声鲁棒性和一定域外泛化能力。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作构建了物理约束的无监督自编码器框架，从固态量子体系的实验输运数据中直接反演有效哈密顿量参数。方法将 S 矩阵形式嵌入解码器，并在三量子点链数值实验中表现出参数识别、域外泛化和抗噪声能力。
full_list.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的机器学习哈密顿量、电子结构计算及量子输运方向高度相关，但其对象是实验量子模拟器而非原子尺度材料。物理先验嵌入机器学习模型、从观测量反演可解释哈密顿量的范式，可借鉴到 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量预测和输运实验数据分析。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其物理解码器、参数可辨识性和模型容量限制的处理。可进一步将框架扩展至 Wannier 哈密顿量、含自旋轨道耦合体系或缺陷/界面输运数据，并比较与监督式哈密顿量学习的泛化差异。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Dual Charge-Density-Waves in Two-dimensional DyTe3 and Their Distinct Impacts on Magneto-Transport Properties
full_list.title_zh: 二维 DyTe3 中的双电荷密度波及其对磁输运性质的不同影响
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge-density-waves (CDWs) are macroscopic quantum states defined by periodic modulations in electronic charge density coupled with lattice distortions. Despite significant research efforts, the evolution of electromagnetic transport properties in the presence of CDWs remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the effects of two orthogonal CDWs (CDW1 and CDW2) coexisting at low-temperature in DyTe3 on its electronic transport properties. Importantly, we find that while no clear magnetotransport anomaly is resolved across CDW1 transition under the present experimental conditions, the emergence of CDW2 drives a drastic enhancement in magnetoresistance and a multiband-governed nonlinear Hall response. These results demonstrate that CDW1 and CDW2 in DyTe3 are fundamentally different and impact its electronic transport in qualitatively distinct ways, establishing DyTe3 as a model system for understanding the transport consequences of multiple CDWs in quasi-two-dimensional materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文报告了低温 DyTe3 中共存的两个正交电荷密度波 CDW1 和 CDW2 对电子输运性质的影响。实验发现，在当前条件下，跨越 CDW1 转变未观察到明显磁输运异常；而 CDW2 的出现会显著增强磁阻，并产生由多能带主导的非线性霍尔响应。结果表明，DyTe3 中的两个电荷密度波具有本质差异，并以定性不同的方式影响电子输运，使其成为研究准二维材料中多重电荷密度波输运后果的模型体系。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电荷密度波（CDW）是由电子电荷密度的周期性调制以及与之耦合的晶格畸变所定义的宏观量子态。尽管研究工作投入巨大，但 CDW 存在时电磁输运性质的演化仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们报告了低温下共存于 DyTe3 中的两个正交 CDW（CDW1 和 CDW2）对其电子输运性质的影响。重要的是，我们发现，在当前实验条件下，跨越 CDW1 转变时没有分辨出明显的磁输运异常；而 CDW2 的出现则导致磁阻显著增强，并产生由多能带控制的非线性霍尔响应。这些结果表明，DyTe3 中的 CDW1 和 CDW2 在本质上不同，并以定性不同的方式影响其电子输运，从而确立了 DyTe3 作为理解准二维材料中多重 CDW 输运后果的模型体系。
full_list.summary: 本文报告了低温 DyTe3 中共存的两个正交电荷密度波 CDW1 和 CDW2 对电子输运性质的影响。实验发现，在当前条件下，跨越 CDW1 转变未观察到明显磁输运异常；而 CDW2 的出现会显著增强磁阻，并产生由多能带主导的非线性霍尔响应。结果表明，DyTe3 中的两个电荷密度波具有本质差异，并以定性不同的方式影响电子输运，使其成为研究准二维材料中多重电荷密度波输运后果的模型体系。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文研究二维 DyTe3 中两个相互正交的电荷密度波及其对磁输运性质的不同影响。结果表明，第二个电荷密度波会显著增强磁阻并产生由多能带主导的非线性霍尔响应，而第一个电荷密度波在当前条件下未表现出明显的磁输运异常。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队关注的电荷密度波、二维材料、强关联磁性材料、磁输运和电子结构方向相关。该工作可为研究电荷序、晶格畸变、磁性以及输运响应之间的耦合提供实验参照，并可结合第一性原理和 Wannier 输运计算进行微观解释。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议通过第一性原理、声子计算和有效哈密顿量分析两个电荷密度波的起源、竞争关系及其对费米面重构的影响。进一步可研究应变、层间堆垛、磁序和缺陷对非线性霍尔效应及多能带输运的调控。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Group theory of Raman effect in magnetic materials
full_list.title_zh: 磁性材料中拉曼效应的群论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.09339v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Despite the wealth of experimental observations on Raman scattering in magnetic materials, the underlying selection rules have remained largely unexplored. In this work, we use Onsager reciprocity relation, other than the conventional corepresentation method, to deal with the mathematical structures of Raman tensors in magnetic groups. Using this approach, we generate Raman tensor tables for all magnetic point groups, and present a comprehensive understanding of the Raman selection rules in magnetic materials with direct product representations method. Our theoretical and numerical results match previous experiments well, and resolve a recent puzzle in the Raman spectroscopy of CrSBr. Moreover, we identify a common but overlooked phenomenon: the magneto-Raman vector can be orthogonal to the magnetic moment direction. Our method and associated Raman tensor tables will be helpful for the Raman studies in both experimental and theoretical domains.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文针对磁性材料拉曼散射选择定则尚未充分阐明的问题，提出使用 Onsager 互易关系处理磁群中拉曼张量的数学结构。作者生成了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并用直积表示方法系统理解选择定则。理论和数值结果与既有实验吻合，解释了 CrSBr 拉曼光谱中的近期疑难，并指出磁拉曼矢量可与磁矩方向正交这一常被忽视的现象。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 尽管磁性材料中的拉曼散射已有大量实验观测，其 underlying 选择定则仍在很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们使用 Onsager 互易关系，而不是传统的共表示方法，来处理磁群中拉曼张量的数学结构。利用这种方法，我们生成了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并采用直积表示方法对磁性材料中的拉曼选择定则给出全面理解。我们的理论和数值结果与先前实验高度吻合，并解决了近期 CrSBr 拉曼光谱中的一个疑难。此外，我们识别出一种常见但被忽视的现象：磁拉曼矢量可以与磁矩方向正交。我们的方法及相关拉曼张量表将有助于实验和理论领域的拉曼研究。
full_list.summary: 本文针对磁性材料拉曼散射选择定则尚未充分阐明的问题，提出使用 Onsager 互易关系处理磁群中拉曼张量的数学结构。作者生成了所有磁点群的拉曼张量表，并用直积表示方法系统理解选择定则。理论和数值结果与既有实验吻合，解释了 CrSBr 拉曼光谱中的近期疑难，并指出磁拉曼矢量可与磁矩方向正交这一常被忽视的现象。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文基于 Onsager 互易关系和直积表示理论，系统推导磁性材料中 Raman 张量的结构，并给出了所有磁点群的 Raman 选择定则表。理论和数值结果与已有实验相符，同时指出磁光 Raman 矢量可能与磁矩方向正交，并讨论了 CrSBr Raman 光谱中的相关问题。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的磁性材料、对称性分析、非共线磁性和磁光性质研究具有直接关联，尤其适合用于分析磁性二维材料和范德华磁体的光谱响应。该工作可为第一性原理计算 Raman 张量、磁序识别及自旋轨道耦合引起的光学各向异性提供群论依据。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可将其磁点群选择定则与第一性原理 Raman 计算、温度依赖自旋动力学及磁畴结构结合，用于研究二维磁体、交替磁体和磁性莫尔体系中的磁光谱特征。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《磁性材料中拉曼效应的群论》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04397v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than (10⁶) atoms.
full_list.summary: 该工作开发了 VBCSR 分布式稀疏矩阵库，用于处理原子轨道基组下不同元素和基组尺寸对应的可变块稀疏量子算符。该库能够自动选择 CSR、BSR 或可变块 CSR 存储形式，并通过同形状块分组和优化稠密核加速大规模线性代数，在超过百万原子的 InP 纳米颗粒计算中得到验证。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作开发了 VBCSR 分布式稀疏矩阵库，用于处理原子轨道基组下不同元素和基组尺寸对应的可变块稀疏量子算符。该库能够自动选择 CSR、BSR 或可变块 CSR 存储形式，并通过同形状块分组和优化稠密核加速大规模线性代数，在超过百万原子的 InP 纳米颗粒计算中得到验证。

full_list.title_en: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
full_list.title_zh: 稀释近藤体系中反常霍尔标度关系的失效
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The confluence of strong electronic correlations and Berry curvature-driven transport constitutes a largely underexplored frontier in quantum materials research, particularly in systems where electronic correlations arise from flat-band physics rather than conventional f-electron states. Here, we report an intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport in the dilute Kondo system Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge, a non-f-electron Heusler alloy hosting flat bands with van Hove singularity proximate to the Fermi level. The anomalous Hall response is strikingly non-monotonic, violating the Fermi-liquid scaling relation near the magnetic transition and is restored only at low temperature, coincident with the onset of Kondo coherence. Ab initio calculations strongly establish that the Berry curvature originates from the Kondo hybridization induced interplay of flat bands and spin-orbit coupling mediated anticrossings at the Fermi level. Our findings demonstrate that Kondo coherence of flat bands bears a profound impact on Berry curvature associated ferroic responses, mandating a rigorous theoretical understanding of anomalous transport in the regime where reciprocal space topology and strong correlations are intrinsically intertwined.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文报告了稀释近藤体系Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge中的本征贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔输运。该非f电子Heusler合金的平带和近费米能级范霍夫奇点使反常霍尔响应呈显著非单调行为，在磁相变附近违反费米液体标度关系；低温近藤相干出现后，该关系才恢复。第一性原理计算表明，贝里曲率源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合反交叉共同作用。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 强电子关联与贝里曲率驱动输运的汇合，是量子材料研究中一个在很大程度上尚未探索的前沿，尤其是在电子关联源于平带物理而非传统f电子态的体系中。在这里，我们报告了稀释近藤体系Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge中的本征贝里曲率驱动反常霍尔输运；该体系是一种非f电子Heusler合金，具有平带及位于费米能级附近的范霍夫奇点。反常霍尔响应呈现显著的非单调性，在磁相变附近违反费米液体标度关系，并且仅在低温下、与近藤相干开始出现相一致时才恢复该关系。第一性原理计算有力地证明，贝里曲率起源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与由自旋轨道耦合介导的费米能级反交叉之间的相互作用。我们的发现表明，平带的近藤相干会深刻影响与贝里曲率相关的铁性响应，因此要求对倒空间拓扑与强关联本征交织区域中的反常输运进行严格的理论理解。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《稀释近藤体系中反常霍尔标度关系的失效》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Excitation caging in a vertex-frustrated quasiperiodic Einstein artificial spin ice
full_list.title_zh: 顶点受挫准周期 Einstein 人工自旋冰中的激发囚禁
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Naturally occurring bulk quasicrystals are rare, and magnetic instances are rarer still, with chemical constraints typically permitting the synthesis of approximants rather than true quasicrystalline magnets. Here, we present an artificial spin ice based on a recently discovered Einstein lattice, the Hat tiling, which is built from the first known shape - the hat - that tiles the plane only aperiodically. The Einstein artificial spin ice has long-range structural order with no translational symmetry, and low-connectivity vertices with well-defined local ground states and excitations. Together, these properties provide a model two-dimensional quasicrystalline magnet, with magnetic correlations that we probe with magnetic force microscopy and parallel-tempered Monte Carlo simulations. We identify a two-stage partial ordering process, driven by the competition between two possible positions for magnetic excitations. This competition is resolved in the ground-state manifold, where exactly one magnetic excitation is caged on each antihat, yet the manifold remains macroscopically degenerate. This yields an unusual type of medium-range order, where the underlying quasiperiodic long-range order is randomly modulated by a strictly constrained disorder. Our findings establish the Einstein artificial spin ice as a blueprint for understanding quasicrystalline magnetism, demonstrating how quasiperiodic monotile geometries can be exploited to engineer unconventional magnetic phases with no direct equivalent in periodic systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 天然存在的块体准晶体十分稀少，磁性准晶体则更为罕见，因为化学限制通常只能合成近似准晶体。本文提出一种基于帽形铺砌 Einstein 晶格的人工自旋冰，其具有长程结构有序性但没有平移对称性。磁力显微镜和并行回火蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了由磁激发位置竞争驱动的两阶段部分有序过程，并发现基态流形中每个反帽形单元恰好囚禁一个磁激发，同时仍保持宏观简并。该体系为研究准晶磁性和设计周期体系中没有直接对应物的非常规磁相提供了模型平台。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 天然形成的块体准晶体十分稀少，而磁性准晶体则更加罕见，因为化学限制通常只能允许合成近似晶体，而不是真正的准晶磁体。在此，我们提出一种基于最近发现的 Einstein 晶格的人工自旋冰，该晶格采用帽形铺砌构成；帽形是已知的第一个只能以非周期方式铺满平面的形状。Einstein 人工自旋冰具有长程结构有序性，却没有平移对称性，并包含具有确定局域基态和激发态的低连接度顶点。这些性质共同构成了一个理想的二维准晶磁体模型，我们利用磁力显微镜和并行回火蒙特卡洛模拟探测其中的磁关联。我们发现了一个由两种可能的磁激发位置之间的竞争驱动的两阶段部分有序过程。在基态流形中，这种竞争得到解决：每个反帽形单元上恰好囚禁一个磁激发，但该流形仍然具有宏观简并性。这产生了一种不寻常的中程有序，其中基础性的准周期长程有序被严格受约束的无序随机调制。我们的发现确立了 Einstein 人工自旋冰作为理解准晶磁性的蓝图，并展示了如何利用准周期单瓦片几何结构设计在周期体系中没有直接对应物的非常规磁相。

full_list.title_en: Engineering Giant Thermoelectric Performance through Electrode-Coupling Geometry and Magnetic Flux in Quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Rings
full_list.title_zh: 通过电极耦合几何与磁通工程化准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger环中的巨型热电性能
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate coherent thermoelectric transport in magnetic-flux-threaded quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) rings with engineered multi-site electrode couplings using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism within the Landauer-Büttiker framework. We demonstrate that the electrode-coupling geometry serves as a powerful control parameter for tailoring quantum interference, thereby reshaping the transmission spectrum and thermoelectric response. In the absence of magnetic flux, the trivial dimerized phase (t₁>t₂) exhibits the highest thermoelectric efficiency, with asymmetric coupling producing a substantially larger figure of merit than the symmetric geometry. Magnetic flux further reconstructs the transmission spectrum through Aharonov-Bohm interference, driving a crossover of the optimal thermoelectric regime from the trivial to the topological dimerized phase. Under optimal flux conditions, the thermoelectric figure of merit reaches ZT approx 12 for symmetric coupling and is dramatically enhanced to ZT approx 90 for asymmetric coupling through enhanced energy filtering and suppressed electronic thermal transport. We further establish a clear correlation between the enhancement of thermoelectric efficiency and the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. Our results demonstrate that the combined interplay of quasiperiodicity, topology, magnetic flux, and electrode-coupling geometry provides a versatile strategy for engineering high-performance coherent thermoelectric devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文利用非平衡格林函数和Landauer-Büttiker框架，研究了穿磁通的准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger环中的相干热电输运。结果表明，电极耦合几何能够调控量子干涉、重塑透射谱和热电响应；磁通则可通过Aharonov-Bohm干涉使最优热电区域从平庸二聚化相转移到拓扑二聚化相。在最佳磁通条件下，热电优值ZT在对称和非对称耦合下分别可达约12和90，并与Wiedemann-Franz定律的破缺密切相关。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用 Landauer-Büttiker 框架下的非平衡格林函数形式主义，研究了具有工程化多位点电极耦合、受磁通穿透的准周期 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）环中的相干热电输运。我们表明，电极耦合几何构型是调控量子干涉的一个强有力控制参数，因而能够重塑透射谱和热电响应。在不存在磁通时，平庸二聚化相（t₁>t₂）表现出最高的热电效率，且非对称耦合产生的品质因子显著高于对称几何构型。磁通还会通过 Aharonov-Bohm 干涉进一步重构透射谱，从而推动最优热电工作区间由平庸二聚化相向拓扑二聚化相交叉转变。在最优磁通条件下，对称耦合时热电品质因子达到 ZT 约 12；通过增强能量过滤并抑制电子热输运，非对称耦合时该值被显著提高至 ZT 约 90。我们还建立了热电效率增强与 Wiedemann-Franz 定律失效之间的明确关联。我们的结果表明，准周期性、拓扑性、磁通和电极耦合几何构型的协同作用，为设计高性能相干热电器件提供了一种多用途策略。

full_list.focus_summary: 该工作利用非平衡格林函数和 Landauer-Buttiker 输运理论，研究准周期 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 环中电极耦合几何和磁通对热电输运的调控。结果表明，不对称多位点耦合及 Aharonov-Bohm 干涉可重构透射谱，并在特定拓扑相和磁通条件下获得很高的理论热电优值。

full_list.title_en: Cascade spin dynamics of excitons localized in indirect-band-gap (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with type-I band alignment
full_list.title_zh: I 型能带排列间接带隙（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的级联自旋动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the spin dynamics of excitons localized in type I (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with an indirect in momentum space band structure. Polarized selective photoluminescence spectroscopy, i.e. fluorescence line narrowing, under magnetic fields up to 5 T applied in the Faraday geometry is employed. The experiment reveals a cascade spin evolution process of excitons in the indirect band-gap quantum dots: an initial short term spin dynamics associated with excited direct exciton states possessing a large oscillator strength is followed by electron relaxation into the X valley of the Brillouin zone and subsequent long term spin dynamics of indirect excitons. The two step mechanism manifests itself in the distinct features of the magnetic field dependences of photoluminescence: two component recovery of optical orientation, two component linear to circular polarization conversion and the presence of the linear polarization plane rotation. At the same time, suppression of the optical alignment shows one-component behavior governed by the spin dynamics of the indirect exciton states. Within the pseudospin formalism, we derive analytical expressions that quantitatively describe the observed dependences and yield estimates for the anisotropic exchange splitting: 210 μeV for direct excitons and 1.3 μeV for indirect excitons. Further analysis using the density matrix formalism agrees well with the pseudospin model calculations and shows that the finite optical orientation at zero magnetic field is due to comparable magnitudes of the anisotropic splitting of the indirect exciton states and the splitting of the X-valley electron states caused by the hyperfine interaction with nuclei.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有动量空间间接能带结构的 I 型（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学，并通过磁场下的偏振选择性光致发光谱进行探测。实验揭示了级联自旋演化过程：具有较大振子强度的激发直接激子先经历短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫至布里渊区的 X 谷并产生间接激子的长时自旋动力学。伪自旋和密度矩阵分析定量解释了实验结果，并分别得到直接激子和间接激子的各向异性交换劈裂约为 210 μeV 和 1.3 μeV。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有动量空间间接能带结构的 I 型（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学。实验采用偏振选择性光致发光谱，即荧光线窄化技术，并在法拉第几何下施加最高 5 T 的磁场。实验揭示了间接带隙量子点中激子的级联自旋演化过程：首先是与具有较大振子强度的激发直接激子态相关的短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫至布里渊区的 X 谷，并产生间接激子的长时自旋动力学。这种两步机制体现在光致发光磁场依赖性的明显特征中，包括光学取向的双组分恢复、线偏振到圆偏振转换的双组分行为以及线偏振面旋转的出现。同时，光学排列的抑制表现出单组分行为，并由间接激子态的自旋动力学控制。在赝自旋形式下，我们推导了解析表达式，定量描述了所观测的依赖关系，并得到各向异性交换劈裂的估计值：直接激子为 210 μeV，间接激子为 1.3 μeV。进一步采用密度矩阵形式进行的分析与赝自旋模型计算符合良好，并表明零磁场下仍存在有限光学取向，是由于间接激子态的各向异性劈裂与 X 谷电子态由核超精细相互作用引起的劈裂具有相近的大小。
full_list.summary: 本文研究了具有动量空间间接能带结构的 I 型（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学，并通过磁场下的偏振选择性光致发光谱进行探测。实验揭示了级联自旋演化过程：具有较大振子强度的激发直接激子先经历短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫至布里渊区的 X 谷并产生间接激子的长时自旋动力学。伪自旋和密度矩阵分析定量解释了实验结果，并分别得到直接激子和间接激子的各向异性交换劈裂约为 210 μeV 和 1.3 μeV。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文通过偏振选择性光致发光实验研究间接带隙 InAlAs/AlAs 量子点中的激子自旋动力学，发现先经历具有较大振子强度的直接激子态自旋演化，随后电子弛豫到 X 谷并进入间接激子态的长时间自旋演化。作者利用赝自旋形式分析了磁场下光学取向、线偏振到圆偏振转换及偏振面旋转等现象。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队关注的自旋动力学、半导体量子体系、载流子弛豫和光激发过程具有部分相关性，但该工作以实验光谱和赝自旋分析为主，未涉及第一性原理或机器学习模拟。其直接到间接激子转化的动力学图景可为非绝热分子动力学和热载流子弛豫研究提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可结合含自旋轨道耦合的第一性原理计算和非绝热动力学，定量研究电子谷间散射、激子自旋弛豫及量子点界面结构对发光寿命的影响。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《I 型能带排列间接带隙（In,Al）As/AlAs 量子点中局域激子的级联自旋动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Band Gaps and Localization of Surface Waves at Hyperbolic Material and Topological Insulator Interfaces
full_list.title_zh: 双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面处表面波的带隙和局域化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop analytical criteria for surface electromagnetic waves at interfaces between hyperbolic materials and topological insulators. The analysis identifies propagation conditions, field penetration depths, and spectral band gaps. In the lossless model, the band edge is governed primarily by dielectric contrast, while the bulk topological coupling produces only a small shift and a weak correction to the dispersion. For structures combining hexagonal boron nitride with bismuth selenide, a thin topological insulator film on a dielectric substrate with low permittivity can substantially broaden the accessible propagation window. We also analyze a dissipative titanium and silicon hyperbolic effective medium interfaced with bismuth selenide. To make the complex branch structure visible, this lossy calculation uses an intentionally enhanced interface response and is therefore illustrative rather than a quantitative prediction for a conventional topological insulator. In the lossy case, a root of the dispersion relation represents a physical guided mode only when the fields decay away from the interface, attenuate consistently along the propagation direction, have finite penetration depths, and exhibit a consistent energy flow profile. Apparent gaps and jumps can occur when the complex quantities controlling transverse decay approach square root branch cuts. These results provide design guidelines for controlling dispersion, confinement, band gaps, and propagation loss in mid-infrared photonic structures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文建立双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面表面电磁波的解析判据，分析其传播条件、场穿透深度和谱带隙。无损模型中，带边主要由介电对比决定，体拓扑耦合仅引起微小色散修正；低介电常数衬底上的薄拓扑绝缘体膜可显著扩大六方氮化硼与硒化铋结构的可传播窗口。针对有损体系，作者强调只有满足横向衰减、沿传播方向一致衰减、有限穿透深度及一致能流等条件的色散根才代表物理导模。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面处表面电磁波的解析判据。该分析确定了传播条件、场穿透深度和谱带隙。在无损模型中，带边主要由介电对比控制，而体拓扑耦合仅导致微小的位移和对色散关系的弱修正。对于由六方氮化硼和硒化铋构成的结构，位于低介电常数衬底上的薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜能够显著拓宽可达的传播窗口。我们还分析了与硒化铋相接的、有耗钛和硅双曲有效介质。为了使复杂的支结构可见，这一有耗计算采用了有意增强的界面响应，因此它是说明性的，而不是对常规拓扑绝缘体的定量预测。在有耗情形下，色散关系的一个根只有在满足下列条件时才代表物理导模：场远离界面衰减、沿传播方向以一致方式衰减、具有有限穿透深度，并呈现一致的能流分布。当控制横向衰减的复数量接近平方根分支切线时，可能出现表观带隙和跳变。这些结果为控制中红外光子结构中的色散、约束、带隙和传播损耗提供了设计准则。

full_list.focus_summary: 论文解析研究双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面上的表面电磁波，推导了传播条件、场穿透深度和频谱带隙，并分析了无损和耗散情况下的色散关系。以六方氮化硼、碲化铋及金属硅等体系为例，论文讨论了介电反差、拓扑耦合和界面损耗对导模窗口的影响。

full_list.title_en: Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) incorporating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have largely been designed around porous architectures, based on the assumption that high internal surface area is the primary driver for triboelectric enhancement. Herein, we demonstrate that a dense, nominally nonporous MOF called ZIF-zni can instead function as an effective high-loading filler within a tribopositive polyurethane (PU) matrix, offering a design strategy for harnessing interfacial electromechanical effects. A 20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU composite delivers an output voltage of 470+/-15 V and a peak power density of 1.31+/-0.03 W m-2 against polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The device exhibits stable performance over ~94,000 cycles under a contact force of ~100 N, and it remains operational under higher impact beyond 500 N. This concept enables the demonstration of a proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile. Combined experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the performance enhancement arises from favourable interfacial polarization, reduced dielectric screening, and surface accessible ZIF-zni rich domains, rather than porosity alone. These features are accompanied by reduced work of adhesion and modified surface roughness, hence improving contact electrification. These findings establish dense MOFs as an effective triboelectric filler and identify interfacial electronic structure and polarization as key design parameters for engineering mechanical energy harvesters and self-powered sensors.
full_list.summary: 该工作提出以致密、近乎无孔的 ZIF-zni 金属有机框架作为聚氨酯复合摩擦电材料的高负载填料，用于机械能采集。实验显示复合材料具有较高输出和循环稳定性，理论与实验共同表明增强机制主要来自界面极化、较弱介电屏蔽及表面富集的 ZIF-zni 区域，而非传统认为的高孔隙率。

full_list.title_en: From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Glyphosate is a widely used herbicide whose persistence and toxicity in aquatic and terrestrial environments demand efficient removal strategies. Here we employ GFN2 xTB calculations with implicit ALPB aqueous solvation and automated docking to investigate the adsorption of all five pH dependent ionized forms of glyphosate (G1-G5) on (10,0) single walled carbon nanotubes covalently functionalized with carboxyl groups at 0-25% coverage. Adsorption energies reveal a clear charge dependent trend: the dianionic (G4) and trianionic (G5) species exhibit the most negative binding energies over the entire functionalization range, while the protonated and neutral forms (G1, G2) bind weakly, approaching reversible adsorption at high COOH contents. The deprotonated form G5 strengthens from -2.17 eV on pristine CNT to about -5.7 eV at 10% and 25% functionalization, with a local minimum near 15-20% COOH due to steric and electrostatic crowding of adjacent groups. Decomposition of the solvation free energy shows dominant electrostatic stabilization complemented by increasingly favorable hydrogen bond contributions as carboxyl density grows. All complexes display very small HOMO-LUMO gaps (0.02-0.22 eV), indicating high electronic sensitivity to adsorption and functionalization. Overall, CNT+COOH systems can operate in both strong capture and regenerable regimes depending on glyphosate ionization state, offering a tunable platform for pH responsive remediation.

full_list.title_en: From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT) provides an efficient continuum framework for studying structure formation in inhomogeneous polymer systems, but its predictive accuracy depends on the choice of the nonlocal mobilities. Here, we construct mobility functions for moderately and strongly entangled homopolymer and diblock copolymer systems from the relaxation dynamics of single-chain structure factors, based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the Kremer-Grest model and analytical reptation theory. Single- chain mobilities are combined such that the resulting DSCFT accounts for the dependence of fluxes on local chain densities. The theory is then applied to the spinodal decomposition of symmetric homopolymer blends and diblock copolymer melts following a quench into the (micro)phase-separation regime. Predictions of DSCFT are systematically compared with MD simulations. Mobility functions derived from single-chain dynamics are found to reproduce the kinetics of structure formation more accurately than conventional Debye-type mobilities. We additionally investigate the influence of adding stochastic currents (noise) that are correlated according to the fluctuation-dissipation relation. At low noise levels, they enable the generation of equilibrium initial states and facilitate defect annealing. At high noise levels, however, nonolinear effects lead to discrepancies between DSCFT and MD simulations.

full_list.title_en: Dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states in a spin-1 triangular antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 自旋-1三角反铁磁体中的偶极与四极自旋超固态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic numerical study of the spin-1 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice in an out-of-plane magnetic field, using Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) methods. By mapping out the quantum phase diagram as a function of the single-ion anisotropy D_z and magnetic field, we identify distinct dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states, characterized by spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking with finite spin superfluid stiffness coexisting with longitudinal translational symmetry breaking. At zero field, the dipolar spin supersolid with a 'Y'-type spin configuration persists down to D_z = 0, whereas the quadrupolar spin supersolid prevails at large D_z. At intermediate fields, the phase diagram is dominated by an up-up-down phase. At high fields below saturation, a quadrupolar spin superfluid emerges in the large-D_z regime, whereas a dipolar spin supersolid with a 'V'-type spin configuration dominates at small D_z. These phases are characterized through their order parameters and spin superfluid stiffness using calculations on various system sizes. Furthermore, the dynamical spin structure factor is obtained across the phase diagram, where characteristic spectral signatures of different phases are observed, including the gapless Goldstone mode and the roton-like minima. These features are directly accessible to inelastic neutron scattering experiments. Our results provide a theoretical understanding of the interplay between frustrations, anisotropy, and Zeeman interactions in driving distinct spin supersolid phases in the spin-1 system, which are relevant to various triangular-lattice antiferromagnets such as Na₂BaNi(PO₄)₂ and K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度矩阵重整化群方法，系统研究了面外磁场下自旋-1三角晶格反铁磁海森堡模型的量子相图。研究发现，随单离子各向异性和磁场变化，体系可呈现偶极与四极自旋超固态，其中超流刚度与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。不同相具有可由非弹性中子散射探测的特征性动力学谱，包括无能隙Goldstone模和类旋子极小值。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法，对外加垂直磁场中的三角晶格自旋-1 反铁磁 Heisenberg 模型进行了系统数值研究。通过绘制关于单离子各向异性 D_z 和磁场的量子相图，我们识别出不同的偶极和四极自旋超固态；这些状态的特征是自发 U(1) 对称性破缺，具有有限自旋超流刚度，并与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。在零磁场下，具有“Y”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态可一直存在至 D_z = 0，而四极自旋超固态在较大 D_z 下占主导。在中间磁场下，相图主要由上-上-下相主导。在饱和前的高磁场下，大 D_z 区域出现四极自旋超流体，而小 D_z 区域则由具有“V”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态占主导。通过对不同系统尺寸的计算，利用其序参量和自旋超流刚度对这些相进行了刻画。此外，我们获得了整个相图中的动力学自旋结构因子，并观察到不同相的特征谱学信号，包括无能隙 Goldstone 模和类旋子极小值。这些特征可由非弹性中子散射实验直接探测。我们的结果为理解阻挫、各向异性和 Zeeman 相互作用如何在自旋-1 体系中驱动不同自旋超固态之间的相互作用提供了理论依据，这些结果与 Na2BaNi(PO4)2 和 K2Ni(SeO3)2 等多种三角晶格反铁磁体相关。
full_list.summary: 本文利用密度矩阵重整化群方法，系统研究了面外磁场下自旋-1三角晶格反铁磁海森堡模型的量子相图。研究发现，随单离子各向异性和磁场变化，体系可呈现偶极与四极自旋超固态，其中超流刚度与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。不同相具有可由非弹性中子散射探测的特征性动力学谱，包括无能隙Goldstone模和类旋子极小值。
full_list.method_point: 工作针对面外磁场中的自旋1三角晶格反铁森模型，采用密度矩阵重整化群扫描单离子各向异性和磁场，保留局域三维自旋自由度并控制有限圆柱或条带的纠缠截断误差。通过基态能量、磁化、偶极与四极序参量、结构因子和超流刚度识别相边界，再计算动态关联函数，区分无能隙Goldstone模与类旋子极小值，建立偶极和四极超固态的可观测谱特征。
full_list.related_work: 这项工作不是机器学习势，而是可作为团队自旋哈密顿量和量子磁性方向的高精度基准；其四极序超越经典自旋纹理，补充Hongjun Xiang关于非共线磁性、拓扑磁态和有效模型的研究。与DFT加线性自旋波只描述弱涨落不同，DMRG能够处理强量子涨落和多序参量竞争；Hongyu Yu可据此训练自旋构型能量模型，Xin-Gao Gong则可把磁振子谱耦合到输运或非绝热动力学。
full_list.implication: 可将该模型路线迁移到CrI3、CrSBr或层状三角磁体：先由DFT+U、含自旋轨道耦合的非共线计算拟合交换、单离子各向异性和可能的双二次项，再用DMRG或张量网络校正经典自旋模型预测。对比不同层间堆垛、应变和电场下的偶极/四极关联函数，并以非弹性中子散射、拉曼磁振子峰和场依赖磁化率验证；机器学习只用于加速参数扫描，不替代量子基准。

full_list.title_en: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.

full_list.title_en: Gapped topological spin-orbital liquid on the honeycomb lattice
full_list.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格上的有能隙拓扑自旋—轨道液体
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.06549v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We perform large-scale density matrix renormalization group simulations of the SU(4) Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice to address the long-standing question of its ground state in an unbiased and quantitatively controlled manner. We find reliable numerical evidence that the ground state is a gapped spin-orbital liquid, presumably with a Z₄ topological order, characterized by a finite topological entanglement entropy close to ln(4), the absence of both SU(4) and lattice symmetry breaking, and a variationally optimized ground-state energy well below the previously proposed π-flux variational state. By exploiting full SU(4) symmetry and keeping up to 12,800 SU(4) multiplets, corresponding to more than one million U(1) states, we achieve unprecedented accuracy for two-dimensional SU(4) quantum magnets. Finite-size scaling of energies and entanglement entropies supports a robust gapped phase in the two-dimensional limit, while a gapless critical state on narrow cylinders is identified as a proximate remnant of a Dirac spin-orbital liquid. Our results find the SU(4) honeycomb Heisenberg model a realization of a gapped topological spin-orbital liquid and provide convincing numerical evidence for topological order in a highly symmetric two-dimensional quantum magnet.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟研究蜂窝晶格 SU(4) 海森堡模型的基态。结果为一种有能隙自旋—轨道液体提供了可靠数值证据，该相可能具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，并且不表现 SU(4) 或晶格对称性破缺。有限尺寸标度和高精度计算支持二维极限中的稳健有能隙相，同时窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被解释为邻近 Dirac 自旋—轨道液体的残余。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们对蜂窝晶格上的 SU(4) 海森堡模型进行了大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟，以无偏且定量可控的方式解决其基态这一长期存在的问题。我们发现了可靠的数值证据，表明基态是一种有能隙自旋—轨道液体，推测具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，其特征是有限的拓扑纠缠熵接近 ln(4)，不存在 SU(4) 和晶格对称性破缺，并且经变分优化的基态能量显著低于先前提出的 π-通量变分态。通过利用完整的 SU(4) 对称性并保留多达 12,800 个 SU(4) 多重态（对应于超过一百万个 U(1) 态），我们在二维 SU(4) 量子磁体方面实现了前所未有的精度。能量和纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度支持二维极限中稳健的有能隙相，而窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被识别为 Dirac 自旋—轨道液体的邻近残余。我们的结果表明 SU(4) 蜂窝海森堡模型实现了一种有能隙拓扑自旋—轨道液体，并为高度对称二维量子磁体中的拓扑序提供了令人信服的数值证据。
full_list.summary: 本文采用大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟研究蜂窝晶格 SU(4) 海森堡模型的基态。结果为一种有能隙自旋—轨道液体提供了可靠数值证据，该相可能具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，并且不表现 SU(4) 或晶格对称性破缺。有限尺寸标度和高精度计算支持二维极限中的稳健有能隙相，同时窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被解释为邻近 Dirac 自旋—轨道液体的残余。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Customized spin spirals in ferromagnetic thin films
full_list.title_zh: 铁磁薄膜中的可定制自旋螺旋
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The advancement of spintronic nanoscale devices hinges on the ability to flexibly engineer magnetic spin structures in thin-film stacks with precision and control. Meeting this demand remains a challenge for stable non-collinear spin configurations and, more specifically, vertical spin spirals in thin films. Innovative methods are required for their fabrication, stabilization and control. Here, we use oblique-incidence deposition to design and stabilize vertical spin spirals at room temperature and without an external field in magnetic thin films. We induce two crossed uniaxial magnetic anisotropies at the thin film boundaries. These anisotropies are tunable in direction and strength, thus providing control over the angular range and depth profile of the resulting spin spiral. The combination of polarized neutron reflectometry and nuclear resonant scattering enables precise and direct determination of the depth-dependent spin configurations. Our results establish a single-film design approach, in which the surface anisotropies independently serve as controllable design parameters for tailoring the vertical spin-spiral profile. Potential applications include nanoscale energy-storage devices, magnetic sensors, and ferromagnetic-resonance filters, advancing all-spin-based device engineering in general.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文采用斜入射沉积，在室温且无外加磁场条件下设计并稳定了磁性薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋。薄膜两个边界处引入的交叉单轴磁各向异性可在方向和强度上调节，进而控制自旋螺旋的角度范围与深度分布。偏振中子反射和核共振散射直接确定了深度依赖自旋构型，为自旋电子器件中的可编程自旋结构设计提供了单薄膜方案。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学纳米尺度器件的发展取决于能否以精确且可控的方式，在薄膜堆叠结构中灵活设计磁性自旋结构。对于稳定的非共线自旋构型，特别是薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋，满足这一需求仍是一项挑战。其制备、稳定和调控需要创新方法。在这里，我们利用斜入射沉积，在磁性薄膜中设计并稳定了室温、无外加磁场下的垂直自旋螺旋。我们在薄膜边界处诱导出两种交叉的单轴磁各向异性。这些各向异性的方向和强度均可调，从而能够控制所得自旋螺旋的角度范围和深度分布。偏振中子反射与核共振散射相结合，可精确且直接地确定深度依赖的自旋构型。我们的结果建立了一种单薄膜设计方法，其中表面各向异性可独立地作为可控设计参数，用于定制垂直自旋螺旋的分布。潜在应用包括纳米尺度储能器件、磁传感器和铁磁共振滤波器，并总体上推动全自旋器件工程的发展。

full_list.title_en: Evidence of Crystal-Field-Mediated Anisotropic Orbital Rashba Effect in Epitaxial Ru/FM Heterostructure
full_list.title_zh: 外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中晶场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical generation of orbital angular momentum provides a promising route to current-induced torques, yet effective control of orbital Rashba textures still remains challenging, particularly because the role of the interfacial crystal field remains largely unexplored. Here, we report experimental evidence for a crystal-field-mediated interfacial anisotropic orbital Rashba effect (AORE) in epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures. Total orbital torque was disentangled into an isotropic bulk contribution and an in-plane anisotropic interfacial contribution. The latter was strongly suppressed by degrading the crystallinity of either constituent and by inserting a Cu spacer, highlighting the essential roles of coherent interfacial orbital hybridization and direct Ru/ferromagnet contact. These results identify interfacial crystal-field coherency as a key ingredient in manipulating orbital Rashba textures and establish a route toward engineering the symmetry and directionality of orbital torques.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电学产生轨道角动量为电流诱导力矩提供了有前景的途径，但轨道 Rashba 纹理的有效调控仍然困难，尤其是界面晶场的作用尚未得到充分研究。本文在外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中发现了晶场介导的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应的实验迹象。结果表明，相干的界面轨道杂化和直接的 Ru/铁磁体接触对于调控轨道力矩的对称性和方向性至关重要。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电学产生轨道角动量为电流诱导力矩提供了一条有前景的途径，但对轨道 Rashba 纹理进行有效调控仍然具有挑战性，特别是因为界面晶场的作用在很大程度上尚未得到研究。在此，我们报道了外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中存在晶场介导的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应（AORE）的实验证据。我们将总轨道力矩分解为各向同性的体相贡献和面内各向异性的界面贡献。后者在任一组分的晶体质量下降以及插入 Cu 间隔层时都会受到强烈抑制，这凸显了相干界面轨道杂化和 Ru/铁磁体直接接触的关键作用。这些结果表明，界面晶场相干性是操控轨道 Rashba 纹理的关键因素，并确立了一条工程化调节轨道力矩对称性和方向性的路径。
full_list.summary: 电学产生轨道角动量为电流诱导力矩提供了有前景的途径，但轨道 Rashba 纹理的有效调控仍然困难，尤其是界面晶场的作用尚未得到充分研究。本文在外延 Ru/铁磁体异质结构中发现了晶场介导的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应的实验迹象。结果表明，相干的界面轨道杂化和直接的 Ru/铁磁体接触对于调控轨道力矩的对称性和方向性至关重要。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Field-Driven Coupled Magnon--Phonon--Electron Relaxation in Magnetite Using Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamic Formalism
full_list.title_zh: 利用最大熵增长量子热力学形式研究磁铁矿中场驱动的耦合磁振子-声子-电子弛豫
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) formulation is developed for longitudinal nonequilibrium relaxation in magnetite (Fe₃O₄) with coupled electron, phonon, and magnon populations. Material-specific excitation spectra define the thermodynamic state space, while one relaxation parameter for each population sets its kinetic scale. A longitudinal magnetic field shifts the dressed magnon eigenenergies while the occupation basis remains fixed; irreversible redistribution conserves instantaneous energy and electron number while allowing the magnon population to vary. The formulation yields nonequilibrium subsystem temperatures, entropy production, magnetic-work identities, and a coupled small-signal susceptibility incorporating energy-conservation feedback among all three populations; the one-pole Debye response appears only as a limiting case. Numerical results under sinusoidal driving show a transition from nearly quasistatic behavior to frequency-dependent lag, finite-amplitude departure from the linear-response ellipse, and increasing higher-harmonic content. Relaxational work per cycle increases strongly with field amplitude and frequency, while the complex susceptibility is broader and shifted relative to a Debye reference. Entropy production remains positive, and the electron, phonon, and magnon temperatures show distinct excursions followed by secular heating when positive magnetic work is retained without heat rejection. The calculated work represents longitudinal magnon quasiparticle relaxation in a homogeneous single-domain model, not the total core loss of a finite ferrite specimen.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文建立了场驱动的最大熵增长量子热力学（SEAQT）模型，用于描述磁铁矿中电子、声子和磁振子群体耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫。模型引入材料特定的激发谱和分别表征各群体动力学尺度的弛豫参数，并在正弦驱动下揭示了从近似准静态行为到频率相关滞后的转变。结果表明，磁振子、声子和电子之间的能量守恒反馈使响应偏离单极点 Debye 形式，且在保留正磁功而无热排出的情况下会出现持续升温。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了一种场驱动的最大熵增长量子热力学（SEAQT）形式，用于描述磁铁矿（Fe₃O₄）中电子、声子和磁振子群体耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫。材料特定的激发谱定义了热力学状态空间，而每个群体各自的一个弛豫参数则确定其动力学尺度。纵向磁场会移动修饰后的磁振子本征能量，而占据基保持不变；不可逆再分配守恒瞬时能量和电子数，同时允许磁振子数发生变化。该形式给出了非平衡子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式，以及包含三个群体之间能量守恒反馈的耦合小信号磁化率；单极点 Debye 响应仅在极限情况下出现。正弦驱动下的数值结果显示，系统会从近似准静态行为转变为具有频率相关滞后的行为，有限振幅会使系统偏离线性响应椭圆，并导致高次谐波成分增加。每个周期的弛豫功随场振幅和频率显著增加，而复磁化率相对于 Debye 参考响应更宽且发生偏移。当保留正磁功而不进行热排出时，熵产生保持为正，电子、声子和磁振子温度会经历不同的偏离，随后出现持续升温。计算得到的功表示均匀单畴模型中的纵向磁振子准粒子弛豫，而不是有限尺寸铁氧体样品的总磁芯损耗。

full_list.title_en: Orientation selection and superconducting properties of epitaxial Al on ferromagnetic semiconductor (In,Fe)As
full_list.title_zh: 铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 上外延 Al 的取向选择与超导性质
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures provide a versatile platform for exploring spin-dependent superconducting phenomena arising from interfacial proximity effects. In this article, we investigate the structural and superconducting properties of Al thin films grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy on strained Fe-doped ferromagnetic semiconductor (FMS) (In,Fe)As layers. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal the epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al layers, with the growth orientation changing from (110) to (111) as the in-plane lattice constant of (In,Fe)As increases. The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies systematically with the film surface morphology and grain size. In addition, the critical magnetic field of Al exhibits an anomalous decrease below 0.5 K, possibly reflecting magnetic coupling to the underlying FMS (In,Fe)As layer. These findings provide a guideline for material design of epitaxial Al/(In,Fe)As heterostructures, which may serve as a promising platform for investigating proximity-induced superconducting and magnetic phenomena in semiconductor-based hybrid quantum devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究了应变 Fe 掺杂铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 层上原位分子束外延生长的 Al 薄膜的结构与超导性质。实验表明，随着（In,Fe）As 面内晶格常数增大，Al 的生长取向由（110）转变为（111），而其超导临界温度随表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统变化。Al 临界磁场在低于 0.5 K 时出现异常下降，可能反映了其与下方铁磁半导体层之间的磁耦合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 超导体/铁磁体异质结构为探索由界面邻近效应产生的自旋相关超导现象提供了多功能平台。在本文中，我们研究了通过分子束外延原位生长在应变 Fe 掺杂铁磁半导体（FMS）（In,Fe）As 层上的 Al 薄膜的结构和超导性质。X 射线衍射和透射电子显微镜表明，Al 层实现了外延生长并具有单晶结构；随着（In,Fe）As 的面内晶格常数增大，其生长取向由（110）变为（111）。Al 的超导临界温度随薄膜表面形貌和晶粒尺寸发生系统变化。此外，Al 的临界磁场在 0.5 K 以下表现出异常下降，这可能反映了其与下方铁磁半导体（In,Fe）As 层之间的磁耦合。这些发现为外延 Al/（In,Fe）As 异质结构的材料设计提供了指导，该结构有望成为研究半导体基混合量子器件中邻近效应诱导的超导和磁现象的平台。

full_list.title_en: Quantum control and the topological properties of the magnon photo-transport in two-dimensional collinear ferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum control and the topological properties of the magnon photo-transport in two-dimensional collinear ferromagnet
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2504.06852v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate light-induced magnon spin photocurrent (MSPC) and magnon energy photocurrent (MEPC) via the Aharonov-Casher (AC) effect. We treat the influence of the electric field through the AC effect as a perturbative term. Subsequently, we derived explicit expressions for MSPC and MEPC in a two-dimensional, collinear ferromagnetic system. Our theoretical framework is applied to both Hexagonal and Kagome two-dimensional ferromagnetic lattices. We demonstrate that MSPC and MEPC can be modulated by tuning the optical frequency and the material's relaxation time. Furthermore, in the low-frequency and infinite-relaxation-time limit, longitudinal MS(E)PC correlates with the topological properties of the magnon system.

full_list.title_en: Energy landscape of the kagome antiferromagnet: Characterization of multiple energy scales
full_list.title_zh: kagome 反铁磁体的能量景观：多重能量尺度的表征
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.18902v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the energy landscape of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet within its coplanar ground-state manifold. Although coplanar states are degenerate at harmonic order, transitions between them require collective weathervane-loop rotations whose barriers grow strongly with loop size. To characterize this structure, we construct disconnectivity graphs using two complementary approaches: exact enumeration and minimax-barrier calculations for small lattices, and a statistical construction for large lattices based on random walks through configuration space, with loop length used as a proxy for barrier height. The exact landscape reveals a dominant low-barrier scale associated with elementary six-spin loops and a broader higher-barrier sector from longer rearrangements. For large systems, the statistical analysis exposes a hierarchy of barrier scales, including a pronounced six-spin-loop peak and an intermediate scale-free regime of loop lengths. This hierarchy provides a natural basis for multiple dynamical time scales: six-spin loops govern the fastest local relaxation, while slower collective dynamics arise from activation of longer loops. These results show that the coplanar manifold is dynamically rugged, with its low-energy dynamics governed by a hierarchy of loop-mediated barriers.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体在其共面基态流形内的能量景观。虽然共面态在谐波阶简并，但它们之间的转变需要集体风向标环旋转，且势垒随环尺寸显著增大。通过精确枚举、minimax 势垒计算和大体系统计构造，研究揭示了由六自旋环和更长环重排共同形成的分级势垒结构及多重动力学时间尺度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体在其共面基态流形内的能量景观。尽管共面态在谐波阶是简并的，但它们之间的转变需要集体的风向标环旋转，其势垒随环大小强烈增长。为表征这一结构，我们使用两种互补方法构建断连图：对于小晶格，采用精确枚举和 minimax 势垒计算；对于大晶格，则基于构型空间随机游走进行统计构造，并以环长度作为势垒高度的代理。精确能量景观揭示了与基本六自旋环相关的主导低势垒尺度，以及来自更长重排的更宽高势垒区。对于大体系，统计分析显示出势垒尺度的层级结构，包括显著的六自旋环峰和中间的无标度环长区域。这种层级结构为多重动力学时间尺度提供了自然基础：六自旋环支配最快的局域弛豫，而更慢的集体动力学来自更长环的激活。这些结果表明，共面流形在动力学上是崎岖的，其低能动力学由环介导势垒的层级结构支配。

full_list.title_en: Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two conventional Josephson junctions connected in series can reproduce, in the static limit in which the currents through the capacitive and resistive channels are negligible, the current-phase relation of a single effective weak link with tunable transparency. Therefore, the two-junction series can be treated as a single synthetic high-transparency element. Here, we investigate to what extent this mapping remains valid under finite-frequency drive and retaining the junctions' resistive and capacitive terms. The full resistively and capacitively shunted junction equations are compared with an effective synthetic element with tunable transparency that retains the synthetic tunable-transparency current-phase relation together with effective capacitive and dissipative terms, thus reducing the two second order degree of freedom system to a single second order degree of freedom. The resulting single-element dynamics is compared with the complete two-junction system under ac excitation. The agreement is quantified through a normalized root-mean-square error between the full and effective voltage waveforms. A broad low-error region is found at low drive frequency, while pronounced deviations emerge as the drive frequency approaches the relevant plasma-frequency scale and at larger drive amplitudes. The results provide a quantitative dynamical criterion for using the reduced single-element description of a synthetic high-transparency Josephson element in superconducting circuits.

full_list.implication: 对《Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Electrostatic splitting of an Edge Magnetoplasmon Resonator
full_list.title_zh: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器的静电分裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Edge-magnetoplasmon resonators have been proposed as a powerful tool to detect anyons by introducing a quantum point contact into an isolated quantum Hall system probed via radiofrequency radiation. In this paper, we study the effect of a quantum point contact embedded within an edge-magnetoplasmon resonator and how its polarization influences the propagating magnetoplasmonic mode. Combining dc and rf measurements, we unambiguously evidence the signature of both integer (ν = 1 and 2) and fractional quantum Hall states (ν = 4/3 and 2/3) within the radiofrequency transmission signal. Using electrostatic gating, we determine the physical parameters characterizing the electrostatic edge of an AlGaAs/GaAs based two-dimensional electron gas. We extract the dependence of the cavity perimeter with the gate voltage of the quantum point contact and fully characterize the path followed by edge magnetoplasmons in this system. Finally, we provide a geometric model in good agreement with experimental results.
full_list.abstract_zh: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器结合量子点接触，可能成为通过射频探测任意子的有力工具。本文通过直流与射频测量，在射频透射信号中清晰识别出整数和分数量子霍尔态，并利用静电栅压提取AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气边缘的物理参数。研究进一步确定了量子点接触栅压对腔体周长的影响，并建立了与实验符合良好的几何模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 通过在由射频辐射探测的孤立量子霍尔系统中引入量子点接触，边缘磁等离激元谐振器被提出为探测任意子的有力工具。本文研究了嵌入边缘磁等离激元谐振器内的量子点接触的影响，以及其极化如何影响传播的磁等离激元模式。结合直流和射频测量，我们在射频透射信号中明确地观测到整数（ν=1和2）及分数（ν=4/3和2/3）量子霍尔态的特征。利用静电栅控，我们确定了表征基于AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气静电边缘的物理参数。我们提取出腔体周长对量子点接触栅极电压的依赖关系，并完整表征了边缘磁等离激元在该系统中所遵循的路径。最后，我们给出了一个与实验结果高度一致的几何模型。
full_list.summary: 边缘磁等离激元谐振器结合量子点接触，可能成为通过射频探测任意子的有力工具。本文通过直流与射频测量，在射频透射信号中清晰识别出整数和分数量子霍尔态，并利用静电栅压提取AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气边缘的物理参数。研究进一步确定了量子点接触栅压对腔体周长的影响，并建立了与实验符合良好的几何模型。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Field-angle dependence of magnetoresistance in UTe2
full_list.title_zh: UTe₂ 中磁阻的磁场角度依赖性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.17235v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically study angle-resolved magnetoresistance under rotated magnetic field in the normal state of a spin-triplet superconductor UTe₂. The Wannier model derived from a GGA+U calculation shows quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surfaces with warping in the k_z direction, consistent with quantum oscillation measurements in the high magnetic field regime. Solving the semiclassical Boltzmann equation, we show that the Fermi surface geometry gives rise to oscillations in the magnetoresistance when the field is tilted from the c axis toward the a or b axis. By assuming a band-dependent relaxation time, the calculated angle-resolved magnetoresistance is in good agreement with the recent transport experiment. This is direct evidence for the warped Fermi surface revealed by ordinary intraband transport. It suggests that the hole band with long relaxation time dominates electron transport. The field angle dependence of the Hall resistivity is calculated for further experimental verification.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了自旋三重态超导体 UTe₂ 正常态中旋转磁场下的角分辨磁阻。由 GGA+U 得到的 Wannier 模型给出沿 k_z 方向翘曲的准二维费米面，与高场量子振荡实验一致。通过求解半经典 Boltzmann 方程，作者说明费米面几何导致磁阻随磁场倾角振荡，并指出长弛豫时间空穴带主导电子输运。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究自旋三重态超导体 UTe₂ 正常态中旋转磁场下的角分辨磁阻。由 GGA+U 计算导出的 Wannier 模型显示出在 k_z 方向具有翘曲的准二维费米面，这与高磁场区域的量子振荡测量一致。通过求解半经典 Boltzmann 方程，我们表明，当磁场从 c 轴向 a 轴或 b 轴倾斜时，费米面几何会引起磁阻振荡。通过假设能带依赖的弛豫时间，计算得到的角分辨磁阻与近期输运实验高度一致。这是普通带内输运揭示翘曲费米面的直接证据。它表明具有长弛豫时间的空穴带主导电子输运。我们还计算了霍尔电阻率的磁场角度依赖性，以供进一步实验验证。
full_list.summary: 本文从理论上研究了自旋三重态超导体 UTe₂ 正常态中旋转磁场下的角分辨磁阻。由 GGA+U 得到的 Wannier 模型给出沿 k_z 方向翘曲的准二维费米面，与高场量子振荡实验一致。通过求解半经典 Boltzmann 方程，作者说明费米面几何导致磁阻随磁场倾角振荡，并指出长弛豫时间空穴带主导电子输运。

full_list.title_en: Fingerprinting superconductors by disentangling Andreev and quasiparticle currents across tunable tunnel junctions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fingerprinting superconductors by disentangling Andreev and quasiparticle currents across tunable tunnel junctions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.20798v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tunneling Andreev reflection (TAR) spectroscopy offers a powerful new approach to fingerprint superconducting pairing symmetry at the atomic scale. By leveraging the exponential sensitivity of excess tunneling decay rate to Andreev reflection, TAR robustly distinguishes between s-wave, d-wave, and more complex order parameters, overcoming limitations of traditional conductance-based techniques. Here, using atomistic superconducting transport simulations, we show that the additivity of excess decay rate enables clear separation of Andreev and quasiparticle currents. In particular, we reveal how their competition as well as higher-order scattering processes shape both the decay rate spectra and their dependence on the coupling strength. We show that this phenomenology stems from the fact that Andreev reflection dominates mid-gap conductance for s-wave superconductors, it is suppressed for the d-wave, and it coexists with quasiparticle tunneling in sign-changing symmetries if the expectation value for the superconducting gap remains finite. These distinct spectral fingerprints pave the way for atomically resolved identification of unconventional superconducting states.

full_list.title_en: GNN-Guided Graph Coarsening and Adaptive QUBO Penalties for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows on a Quantum Annealer
full_list.title_zh: 面向量子退火器上带时间窗容量约束车辆路径问题的GNN引导图粗化与自适应QUBO惩罚
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph coarsening reduces the large Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) formulations arising when vehicle-routing problems are solved by quantum annealing. Nearby customers with compatible time windows are merged into super-nodes, the reduced problem is solved, and the solution is expanded to the original graph. For the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW), existing coarsening heuristics require family-specific tuning and remain unreliable on random instances. We address these limitations on the Solomon benchmark using simulated annealing and a D-Wave Advantage2 processor. We first introduce adaptive penalty calibration. Uniform penalty scaling has little effect, whereas controlling the internal coefficient range substantially improves raw samples. Removing non-binding constraints, normalising binding ones, and scaling the remaining penalties reduces mean raw constraint violations from 33.0 to 0.06 at the same solver budget (p=3.7e-11, n=56). A variable-count-preserving control attributes this gain to conditioning rather than problem size. Second, we replace the hand-tuned merge score with a graph neural network (GNN) using one configuration across all families. At N=10, it achieves 100% feasibility across all Solomon families, including R-type (100% vs. 80% for the tuned heuristic). Across N=10,...,100, feasibility is 83% vs. 69%, with the GNN better or tied on 85/90 instance-size pairs. At N=80,100, the difference is significant (p=0.002; 25/25 pairs), while the QUBO remains approximately 5-6 times smaller. Finally, hardware experiments reproduce the conditioning effect at fixed logical variable count: feasible samples increase from 0.02% to 39% across 13 instances. Classical repair with local search remains a reference bound for end-to-end solution cost.
full_list.abstract_zh: 图粗化可缩小量子退火求解车辆路径问题时产生的大规模无约束二次二元优化模型。本文针对带时间窗容量约束车辆路径问题，提出自适应惩罚校准和图神经网络驱动的节点合并方法，并在Solomon基准、模拟退火和D-Wave Advantage2处理器上验证。该方法显著降低原始样本的约束违反、提升可行性，并在较大规模问题中保持约5至6倍更小的QUBO规模。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 当利用量子退火求解车辆路径问题时，图粗化可缩小所产生的大规模无约束二次二元优化QUBO公式。具有相近位置且时间窗兼容的客户被合并为超级节点，求解缩减问题后，再将解扩展至原始图。对于带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题，现有粗化启发式方法需要针对问题族进行调参，且在随机实例上仍不可靠。我们使用模拟退火和D-Wave Advantage2处理器，在Solomon基准上解决这些局限。首先，我们引入自适应惩罚校准。统一的惩罚缩放几乎没有影响，而控制内部系数范围则显著改善原始样本。移除非绑定约束、归一化绑定约束并缩放其余惩罚，在相同求解器预算下将平均原始约束违反从33.0降至0.06（p=3.7e-11，n=56）。一个保持变量数不变的对照实验将这一提升归因于条件改善，而非问题规模。其次，我们用图神经网络取代手工调优的合并评分，并针对所有问题族使用同一配置。在N=10时，该方法在所有Solomon问题族上实现100%的可行性，包括R类问题，其中图神经网络为100%，而经调优的启发式方法为80%。在N=10至100的范围内，可行性为83%，而对照启发式方法为69%；在90个实例-规模组合中，图神经网络在85个组合中表现更好或持平。在N=80和100时，差异显著（p=0.002；25/25个组合），同时QUBO仍约小5至6倍。最后，硬件实验在固定逻辑变量数量下复现了条件改善效应：在13个实例中，可行样本比例从0.02%增至39%。带局部搜索的经典修复方法仍是端到端解成本的参考界限。

full_list.title_en: Impact of Data Loss in Postprocessing on Training and Inference of Quantum Neural Networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Impact of Data Loss in Postprocessing on Training and Inference of Quantum Neural Networks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05060v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As quantum hardware scales to larger devices, the classical software layers that interface with it must evolve in step. Postprocessing routines developed and tested primarily in simulator settings can encode assumptions that no longer hold on utility-scale devices, leading to data loss that can be difficult to detect from high-level model outputs alone. We present a case study of textttSamplerQNN, the sampling-based quantum neural network class in the Qiskit Machine Learning library. Here, the postprocessing method applies a filter that assumes measurement bit-strings are in virtual qubit space. On our quantum hardware runs, where bit-strings span over 100 physical qubits, this filter led to the loss of 85 to 99.6% of valid measurement shots, depending on the transpiler's qubit placement. The resulting probability vector is unnormalised, allowing distorted prediction and loss values to propagate through the model without an API-level warning. We demonstrate the impact across five experiments on two IBM backends: for inference, accuracy drops from 0.94 to 0.39 on the same raw measurements; for training, the loss signal is compressed by 22 to 27×, substantially reducing the sensitivity of the optimiser to the objective landscape. The behaviour arises in all released versions of the library (0.8.4 to 0.9.0). We implemented a layout-based marginalisation fix, merged into the GitHub codebase as Pull Request #1041, that makes textttSamplerQNN postprocessing forward-compatible with current and upcoming hardware.

full_list.title_en: LLM-Driven Algorithm Design for Quantum Circuit Synthesis based on Binary Decision Diagrams
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：LLM-Driven Algorithm Design for Quantum Circuit Synthesis based on Binary Decision Diagrams
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuits are central to implementing quantum algorithms on quantum devices, where quantum gates must be reversible. Many quantum algorithms rely on Boolean functions, which must therefore be implemented reversibly within quantum circuits. Reversible circuit synthesis provides a way to translate such Boolean functions into reversible circuits. Binary decision diagrams (BDDs) offer a scalable approach to this task, but the resulting BDDs and circuits depend heavily on variable ordering. Existing ordering heuristics commonly minimize BDD size because it is closely tied to the circuit size. However, BDD size is an imperfect proxy for the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit (QCC). We propose textttQuantumEvo, an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator for QCC-aware BDD variable ordering. Instead of predicting orderings directly, textttQuantumEvo searches over ordering heuristics initialized from multiple heuristic families. Candidate heuristics directly manipulate variable orderings using standard BDD operations and are selected by downstream QCC. The discovered heuristic, HGA-QE, modifies the sifting step inside a genetic algorithm so that the procedure is better aligned with QCC. Across the benchmark set, HGA-QE achieves a 70.9% tie-or-win rate against the per-function best baseline and is strictly best on 13.5% of the functions. The results demonstrate broadly competitive QCC performance, with HGA-QE showing a clearer relative advantage in strict wins on the two benchmark suites drawn from sources different from the data used for heuristic discovery.

full_list.title_en: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
full_list.title_zh: 利用 Quantum ESPRESSO 计算 DFT 自旋—轨道溢出
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了如何从晶体结构计算自旋—轨道溢出（spin-orbit spillage），该量可用于衡量材料具有拓扑特征的可能性，也是相关机器学习分类器所依据的参考量。作者以绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2 为例，使用 Quantum ESPRESSO 分别进行包含和不包含自旋—轨道耦合的计算，并通过波函数重叠分析得到溢出值 2.094，与已发表的 VASP 结果 2.075 相差 0.9%。文章还讨论了相对论赝势的作用以及该流程在半金属中的局限性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本工作描述了如何从晶体结构计算自旋—轨道溢出。自旋—轨道溢出提供了一种衡量材料具有拓扑特征可能性的指标。该溢出量还为 Choudhary 等人的机器学习分类器提供参考量；该分类器预测的是溢出是否超过指定阈值，而不是直接计算其数值。完整的计算流程应用于绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2，得到的溢出值为 2.094，而已发表的 VASP 溢出值为 2.075，两者相差 0.9%。本文从两个 Quantum ESPRESSO（QE）计算出发描述溢出的计算过程，即分别在包含和不包含自旋—轨道耦合的情况下进行计算，并讨论相对论赝势的作用以及随后进行的波函数重叠分析。文章还考察了将同一计算流程用于半金属时的局限性。

full_list.title_en: A mutual information-based metric for temporal expressivity and trainability estimation in quantum policy gradient pipelines
full_list.title_zh: 基于互信息的量子策略梯度流程时间表达性与可训练性估计指标
full_list.abstract: In recent years, various limitations of conventional supervised learning (SL) have been identified, motivating the development of reinforcement learning (RL)–and quantum RL that leverages quantum resources such as entanglement and superposition. Among the various RL methodologies, the policy gradient method is considered to have many benefits; for instance, it allows an agent to learn without explicitly knowing the crucial information of the environment such as state transition probabilities and initial state distribution. Meanwhile, from the perspective of learning, two indicators are often regarded as significant: expressivity and trainability (for gradient-based methods). While a number of attempts have been made to quantify the expressivity and trainability of Neural Network models and parameterized quantum circuits, clear efforts suitable for RL settings have so far been lacking, despite the inherent differences between conventional SL and RL. Therefore, in this study, we propose revising the notion of expressivity into a temporal expressivity suited to RL dynamics, and show that the mutual information (MI) between the action distribution and the discretized reward signal provides an upper bound for the scaled gradient norm, while yielding an information-theoretic decomposition and a residual-aware upper bound for the proposed temporal expressivity metric. Finally, under explicit concentration assumptions, we show that MI-based Temporal Expressivity and Trainability measure induces an assumption-based, one-sided prescreening criterion for initialization-time gradient fragility.
full_list.abstract_zh: 近年来，传统监督学习的局限性推动了强化学习及量子强化学习的发展。本文针对强化学习的时间动态，将表达性重新定义为时间表达性，并证明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息为缩放梯度范数提供上界，同时给出时间表达性指标的信息论分解和考虑残差的上界。在明确的集中性假设下，作者进一步建立了基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量，并将其用于初始化阶段梯度脆弱性的一侧预筛选。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，人们发现传统监督学习（SL）存在各种局限，这推动了强化学习（RL）以及利用纠缠和叠加等量子资源的量子强化学习的发展。在多种强化学习方法中，策略梯度方法被认为具有许多优势；例如，它允许智能体在不知道环境关键先验信息的情况下进行学习，例如状态转移概率和初始状态分布。与此同时，从学习的角度来看，两个指标通常被认为十分重要：表达性以及可训练性（对于基于梯度的方法而言）。尽管已有多项工作尝试量化神经网络模型和参数化量子电路的表达性与可训练性，但针对强化学习场景的清晰研究至今仍然缺乏，尽管传统监督学习与强化学习之间存在固有差异。因此，本研究提出将表达性的概念修订为适用于强化学习动态的时间表达性，并表明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息（MI）为缩放梯度范数提供了一个上界，同时为所提出的时间表达性指标给出一种信息论分解和一种考虑残差的上界。最后，在明确的集中性假设下，我们表明，基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量能够导出一种基于假设、单侧的初始化时梯度脆弱性预筛选准则。
full_list.summary: 近年来，传统监督学习的局限性推动了强化学习及量子强化学习的发展。本文针对强化学习的时间动态，将表达性重新定义为时间表达性，并证明动作分布与离散化奖励信号之间的互信息为缩放梯度范数提供上界，同时给出时间表达性指标的信息论分解和考虑残差的上界。在明确的集中性假设下，作者进一步建立了基于互信息的时间表达性与可训练性度量，并将其用于初始化阶段梯度脆弱性的一侧预筛选。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：强化学习和闭环控制。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Quantum-Assisted Memory-Efficient Training for Parameter-Intensive Wi-Fi-Based Human Activity Recognition
full_list.title_zh: 面向参数密集型Wi-Fi人体活动识别的量子辅助内存高效训练
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.04271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition (HAR) has become an important part of integrated sensing and communications, paving the way for a range of context-aware services. However, most existing Wi-Fi-based HAR systems rely on deep learning (DL) models that are computationally and memory intensive in both training and inference, which poses significant challenges for real-world deployment. Conventional training requires simultaneous updates of millions of parameters, leading to prohibitive memory consumption. In this paper, we propose a novel quantum-assisted memory-efficient training framework (Q-MET) designed to improve efficiency in both training and inference. Q-MET utilizes a hybrid quantum classical neural network to indirectly generate parameters for HAR models, significantly reducing the trainable parameter count compared to direct optimization. To further support the deployment on resource-constrained devices, we integrate structured pruning during the training phase. Experimental results demonstrate that Q-MET achieves a 90% to 95% reduction in trainable parameters compared with conventional backpropagation-based DL training while maintaining or even exceeding classical classification accuracy. Additionally, Q-MET supports lightweight inference through structured pruning, achieving 75% to 85% model sparsity with less than 2% loss in classification accuracy. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first quantum-assisted approach to simultaneously tackle memory inefficiencies in both the training and inference stages of HAR systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别通常依赖训练和推理阶段均计算与内存密集的深度学习模型，制约了实际部署。本文提出量子辅助内存高效训练框架Q-MET，通过混合量子-经典神经网络间接生成模型参数，并在训练阶段整合结构化剪枝。实验表明，该方法可将可训练参数减少90%至95%，同时保持或超过经典分类精度；推理模型可达到75%至85%的稀疏度，分类精度损失低于2%。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别已成为通感一体化的重要组成部分，为一系列情境感知服务铺平了道路。然而，大多数现有的基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别系统依赖深度学习模型，而这些模型在训练和推理中均具有很高的计算和内存需求，这对实际部署构成重大挑战。传统训练要求同时更新数百万个参数，导致难以承受的内存消耗。本文提出一种新颖的量子辅助内存高效训练框架，即Q-MET，旨在提高训练和推理两方面的效率。Q-MET采用混合量子-经典神经网络间接生成用于人体活动识别模型的参数，与直接优化相比显著减少可训练参数数量。为进一步支持在资源受限设备上的部署，我们在训练阶段集成结构化剪枝。实验结果表明，与传统的基于反向传播的深度学习训练相比，Q-MET可将可训练参数减少90%至95%，同时保持甚至超过经典分类精度。此外，Q-MET通过结构化剪枝支持轻量化推理，实现75%至85%的模型稀疏度，同时分类精度损失低于2%。据我们所知，这项工作是首个同时解决人体活动识别系统训练和推理阶段内存低效问题的量子辅助方法。
